parameters.name: CallbackProvisioningConfig
parameters.description: 应用事件回调同步配置，当ProvisionProtocolType为idaas\_callback时，必须填写。

parameters.name: ProvisionPassword
parameters.description:
IDaaS用户事件回调是否同步密码，取值可选范围：
- true：同步密码。
- false：不同步密码。

parameters.name: ProvisionProtocolType
parameters.description:
账户同步协议类型，取值可选范围：
- idaas\_callback：IDaaS自定义事件回调账号同步方式。
- scim2：SCIM协议同步方式。

parameters.name: ScimProvisioningConfig
parameters.description: IDaaS SCIM协议同步配置参数。当ProvisionProtocolType为scim2时，必须填写。

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam set-application-provisioning-config --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --application-id app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --provision-protocol-type idaas_callback --callback-provisioning-config '{"CallbackUrl":"https://example.com/event/callback","EncryptKey":"ad3b24800000000000000000000000000b3561a73d7","ListenEventScopes":["urn:alibaba:idaas:app:event:ud:user:create"],"EncryptRequired":true}' --scim-provisioning-config '{"AuthnConfiguration":{"AuthnParam":{"TokenEndpoint":"https://www.example.com/oauth/token","AuthnMethod":"client_secret_basic","AccessToken":"k52x2ru63rlkflina5utgkxxxx","ClientSecret":"CSEHDcHcrUKHw1CuxkJEHPveWRXBGqVqRsxxxx","ClientId":"mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx"},"GrantType":"bearer_token","AuthnMode":"oauth2"},"ScimBaseUrl":"https://example.com/scim","ProvisioningActions":["urn:alibaba:idaas:app:scim:User:CREATE"],"FullPushScopes":["urn:alibaba:idaas:app:scim:User:PUSH"]}' --provision-password true --network-access-endpoint-id nae_examplexxxx --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam SetApplicationProvisioningConfig --region cn-hangzhou --ScimProvisioningConfig.AuthnConfiguration.AuthnParam.ClientId mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --CallbackProvisioningConfig.ListenEventScopes.1 'urn:alibaba:idaas:app:event:ud:user:create' --ScimProvisioningConfig.ScimBaseUrl 'https://example.com/scim' --ScimProvisioningConfig.AuthnConfiguration.GrantType bearer_token --CallbackProvisioningConfig.EncryptKey ad3b24800000000000000000000000000b3561a73d7 --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --ScimProvisioningConfig.AuthnConfiguration.AuthnMode oauth2 --NetworkAccessEndpointId nae_examplexxxx --ProvisionProtocolType idaas_callback --ScimProvisioningConfig.AuthnConfiguration.AuthnParam.AccessToken k52x2ru63rlkflina5utgkxxxx --CallbackProvisioningConfig.CallbackUrl 'https://example.com/event/callback' --ScimProvisioningConfig.AuthnConfiguration.AuthnParam.AuthnMethod client_secret_basic --ProvisionPassword true --ScimProvisioningConfig.AuthnConfiguration.AuthnParam.ClientSecret CSEHDcHcrUKHw1CuxkJEHPveWRXBGqVqRsxxxx --ScimProvisioningConfig.ProvisioningActions.1 'urn:alibaba:idaas:app:scim:User:CREATE' --ScimProvisioningConfig.FullPushScopes.1 'urn:alibaba:idaas:app:scim:User:PUSH' --CallbackProvisioningConfig.EncryptRequired true --ScimProvisioningConfig.AuthnConfiguration.AuthnParam.TokenEndpoint 'https://www.example.com/oauth/token' --ApplicationId app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --method POST --force
